sections.title: Sound of the letter u
paragraphs: The letter name is (u) /u/. Its main sound appears in (utca) /ˈut.tsɒ/, which means street. This letter makes only one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Pull your tongue back and lift the back of your tongue high. Close your jaw almost completely. Push your lips forward into a small, tight circle. Your vocal cords vibrate to make a voiced sound. Place a hand on your throat to feel the strong buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound heard in (utca) /ˈut.tsɒ/ in every position. You also hear it at the end of (falu) /ˈfɒ.lu/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not let this sound glide like the vowel in boot or rude. Keep your lips and tongue still so the vowel does not slide into another sound. Do not replace it with the vowel in put or foot. Keep your lips pushed firmly forward and tight.
